key_rationale: With headline CPI inflation at 7.44% significantly breaching the upper tolerance limit and food inflation surging to 11.51%, the risks of inflation expectations becoming unanchored have intensified. Given the positive output gap of 0.60% and the necessity to drain excess banking system liquidity of 120,000 crore, a front-loaded policy action is imperative to ensure that the trajectory of inflation aligns with the 4.00% target.
